info.title: AuraPix Tenant Usage API
info.description: Per-tenant daily usage rollups. The canonical pull surface for host billing systems (issue #133).

get.summary: Fetch daily usage rollups for a tenant over a date range
get.description:
Returns one document per UTC day in [from, to] inclusive. Days with no recorded activity are returned as zero-filled docs so callers can iterate without gap handling. Max range: 100 days.

Auth: tenant owner (Bearer) OR host API key with `usage.read` scope.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Inclusive end date, YYYY-MM-DD (UTC). Must be >= from and <= from + 99 days.

400.description: Validation error or range too large

403.description: Caller is not authorized for this tenant

429.description: Per-tenant API rate limit exceeded (issue #154). Token-bucket keyed by `tenantId`, applied to all tenant-scoped routes after `resolveTenant`. The response sets the `Retry-After` header (whole seconds) and emits a sampled `rate_limit.exceeded` metering event (≤1/sec/tenant) which is rolled up into the `rateLimited` counter on the daily usage doc. Defaults: `RATE_LIMIT_RPS=20`, `RATE_LIMIT_BURST=60`; host-key traffic uses `RATE_LIMIT_HOST_RPS=100`. A `tenants_config/{tenantId}` doc may override `rateLimit.rps`/`rateLimit.burst` and takes effect on the next request (no restart).

Retry-After.description: Whole seconds the client should wait before retrying. Always ≥ 1.

storageBytesDelta.description: Net storage bytes change for the day (positive on upload, negative after deletes).

rateLimited.description: Count of requests rejected by the per-tenant rate limiter on this day (issue #154). Aggregated from sampled `rate_limit.exceeded` metering events (sampled to ≤1/sec/tenant). Lets a host chart abuse without consuming the webhook stream.

storageBytesTotal.description: Absolute storage footprint at end-of-day, written by the scheduled snapshot job. Null until the first snapshot for the day completes.

RateLimitErrorResponse.description: Stable error body returned with 429 responses by the per-tenant rate limiter (issue #154). Distinct from the standard ErrorResponse to keep the limiter shape easy to pattern-match in client SDKs.

retryAfterSeconds.description: Same value as the `Retry-After` response header.

RateLimitExceededEvent.description: Metering event emitted when the per-tenant token-bucket limiter rejects a request. Sampled to at most one event per second per tenant to avoid event-bus amplification on a sustained spike. Hosts that prefer aggregate counters can read `rateLimited` from the daily usage rollup instead of consuming this event stream.
